old_caption: The video captures a serene nighttime scene set against a rocky landscape. Illuminated by warm yellow lights, several deer light installations are positioned along the rocky terrain. The installations vary in size and pose, some standing upright while others are in dynamic poses. The reflections of these illuminated figures shimmer on the water below, adding depth and beauty to the scene. The camera pans slowly from left to right, revealing more of the landscape and the detailed arrangement of the installations. The background features a mix of trees and shrubs, contributing to the natural setting.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene nighttime scene set against a rocky landscape. Illuminated by warm yellow lights, several deer statues are positioned along the rocky terrain, creating a tranquil and magical atmosphere. The statues vary in size and pose, some standing upright while others appear to be grazing or interacting with their surroundings. The reflections of these illuminated figures shimmer on the water below, adding depth and beauty to the scene. The camera pans slowly from left to right, revealing more of the landscape and the detailed arrangement of the statues. The background features a mix of trees and shrubs, contributing to the natural setting. The overall ambiance is peaceful and enchanting, enhanced by the interplay of light and shadow.
caption: The video captures a nighttime outdoor scene where a rocky cliff face is washed in cool blue and white light, dotted with bright yellow illuminated deer figures posed standing and grazing at various heights. A calm pool in the foreground mirrors these glowing shapes and the lit rock strata. Bare tree branches rise along the right side of the cliff. As the excerpt unfolds, the viewpoint drifts steadily to the left, sliding each deer across the frame. The glowing figure at the far right edge gradually leaves view, while an antlered deer on a left ledge, partly cut off in the early frames, becomes fully visible. Toward the later frames another yellow deer enters at the extreme left edge. The water reflections shift horizontally in step with this slow pan, keeping the mirrored herd aligned with the moving cliff.

This clip is a temporally cropped excerpt, with arbitrary start and end boundaries. It is NOT
necessarily a complete action and it is NOT a loop. Describe the visible portion of a process
without inventing how it began or how it ultimately ends. A process may already be happening
on the first frame and still be happening after the last. Do not force the endpoints to match,
infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
